{{Top|leg}}
The '''Sluis Van Congregate''' was a conglomerate based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sluis Van/Legends|Sluis Van]] and operated the [[Sluis Van Shipyards]]. These yards were responsible for a large percentrage of the [[Sluissi]] income. 

==History==
Following the death of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]], the Congregate debated on whether or not to lodge complaints against the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] for labor contract violations which lasted for many months though did not deny them access to the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]]. Eventually, they reneged on many contracts from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the time when [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisors]] were fighting amongst themselves for control of the Empire.
